What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p></div><p><strong>Life at THG Nutrition</strong></p> <p data-start="353" data-end="578">THG Nutrition is home to some of the world’s most trusted and best-loved wellbeing and nutrition brands, including Myprotein, the world’s largest online sports nutrition brand, alongside Myvegan, Myvitamins and MP Activewear.</p> <p data-start="580" data-end="776">Our brands and people exist to break boundaries — to power and empower those who want more. We move fast, challenge convention, and back ourselves to win. These values shape how we work every day.</p> <p></p> <div><strong data-olk-copy-source="MailCompose">Role: Senior Assistant Merchandiser </strong></div> <div><strong>Brand: Myprotein</strong></div> <div><strong>Reporting to: Merchandising Manager</strong></div> <div><strong>Location: THG ICON 1, 7-9 Sunbank Lane, WA15 0AF (fully office based) </strong></div> <div> </div> <div><strong>About the Role</strong></div> <div> </div> <div>We are seeking a highly organised, analytical, and proactive <strong>Senior Assistant Merchandiser</strong> to join the MP Activewear Clothing team. This role supports the merchandising function through delivering reporting and analysis that drives key business KPIs, while helping to manage intake and optimise stock performance. The successful candidate will also support the development of junior team members and contribute to the overall success of the team.</div> <div>You will work closely with the Merchandiser and wider teams to help drive sales performance through assisting with range planning, while maintaining strong control over intake and managing key intake deliverables.</div> <div> </div> <div> </div> <div><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></div> <ul> <li>Support in preparing department trade performance analysis, identify opportunities to maximise bestsellers and support the clearance of underperforming stock.</li> <li>Proposing pricing (reprices and markdowns), understanding the relationship and importance of pricing in relation to margin, sell-through rates and other key deliverables.</li> <li>Assist the Merchandiser in managing the Line Card/Rebuy forecasting process, with a clear understanding of supplier lead times and seasonality, to make decisions which positively drive sales and profitability.</li> <li>Support Range Plan forecasting, stock planning, promotional activity and seasonal launches.</li> <li>Assists with ad-hoc reporting to inform decision making across Buying & Merch teams.</li> <li>Overseeing the critical path process, ensuring timely delivery in line with the department key deliverables.</li> <li>Overseeing junior team member development & identifies opportunities to improve processes, efficiencies and ways of working.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Skills & Experience</strong></div> <ul> <li>Relevant merchandising experience operating at Assistant Merchandiser level & looking to progress into a more senior position.</li> <li>Experience using Power BI or similar software to aid reporting is preferable.</li> <li>Strong commercial awareness, numerical and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail.</li> <li>Highly organised, proactive and able to manage multiple priorities independently.</li> <li>Confident communicator with strong problem-solving skills.</li> <li>Strong IT skills, particularly Excel.</li> <li>Positive, self-motivated team player with a continuous improvement mindset </li> </ul> title: Documentation Lead
description: About Artificial Help shape the future of specialty insurance At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making. We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth. You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry. We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally. Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations. About the role At Artificial, there are three primary sources of documentation we maintain: Client-facing product documentation for insurance business users (brokers, underwriters and operations teams using our platform) Our internal documentation site, which is our most heavily used documentation surface, built docs-as-code from the engineering repository and authored largely by engineers. Our public API documentation, owned and authored by our Integrations team from auto-generated OpenAPI specifications. The below responsibilities break down how each of these three sources are to be managed. Responsibilities Own the client-facing product documentation (1) end-to-end: strategy, information architecture, standards, tooling and content quality Own the internal documentation gap backlog (2): proactively identify potential gaps and triage incoming gap reports route each one to the best-placed author and chase it to completion write the content yourself where you're the right author Steward the internal documentation site (2) and public API documentation (3): set the standards, information architecture and editorial bar for content authored by engineering and integrations teams, and keep the publishing pipelines healthy Interview engineers about new features as they ship, and demystify them for non-technical readers before anyone has to ask Act as editorial reviewer on documentation changes, catching duplication, misplacement and unclear writing before it ships Write and maintain the highest-value client-facing content yourself: core product guides and release communications Select, build and run the documentation toolchain, including docs-as-code workflows (static site generators, CI/CD, review gates) where they serve us best Design and operate AI-assisted authoring pipelines that raise quality and throughput without sacrificing accuracy Build the contribution model: templates, style standards and review processes that let product managers and engineers contribute content you curate rather than gatekeep Partner with the Integrations team on API documentation: raise the quality of guides and examples around the auto-generated reference without taking authorship away from the experts Partner with product and customer-facing teams so documentation ships with releases, not after them Measure whether documentation is working: usage, search behaviour, support deflection and client feedback, and act on what you find Set the standard for clear technical communication across the company About you 6+ years in technical writing, documentation engineering or a closely related discipline Preferably an ex Engineer who has stepped into technical writing / documentation Demonstrable experience producing end-user product documentation, plus enough developer documentation experience to edit and improve API guides credibly Hands-on experience owning documentation tooling, including docs-as-code workflows (for example Git-based authoring, static site generators, CI pipelines) A portfolio or writing samples that show you can make complex technical material clear for both technical and non-technical readers Used to working in a fast-paced, technological environment, with all the ambiguities this presents: flexibility will be needed Confident in reading and understanding code and pull requests, so that you are able to identify where documentation might need adding/editing We especially want to hear from you if you have: Built or substantially restructured a documentation estate, not just contributed to one Experience establishing contribution models where engineers and product managers write and you edit and curate Practical experience using LLMs in documentation workflows, with a clear-eyed view of where they help and where they fail Familiarity with structured documentation frameworks such as Diataxis Familiarity with OpenAPI specifications and generating reference documentation from source Previously worked in a scale-up environment Come from an InsurTech, FinTech or other regulated-industry background Benefits Private medical insurance Income protection insurance Life insurance of 4 * base salary On-site gym and shower facilities Enhanced maternity and paternity pay Team social events and company parties Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform Company stock options managed through Ledgy Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us! We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point. Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts. As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Lead Forward Deployed Designer
description: About Artificial Help shape the future of specialty insurance At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making. We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth. You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry. We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally. Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations. About the role Today, a key part of delivery has no clear owner: problem framing before configuration begins. On the customer side, there are rarely UX specialists - only domain experts and sponsors who describe needs as pre-formed solutions. On our side, configured workspaces are built by Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) in our Transform team: experts in the platform, accountable for shipping to a deadline, but not trained designers. Our Platform teams have design expertise but are often too far removed from individual implementations to influence the moments that matter most. The result is pretty predictable: we move quickly into “how” before we are confident about the “what” and “why.” Your mandate is to slow down at the right moment and make sure we’re solving the right problem - then help the team implement the best platform-valid solution. This is a founding role. You would be the first Forward Deployed Designer (FDD) at Artificial, hired into an enabling function within the Platform team, with the mandate to define how the function works and to build it out. Later, FDDs would join the Transform teams in hands-on client roles: you’d take part in hiring them (with our support), then line-manage them directly. Responsibilities You would work closely with the Transform team and customers throughout discovery and delivery. In practice, that means: Establish the FDD function. title: Sales Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. to demos and sales;  to ensuring successful account switch and activation.</li> <li>Guiding customers through Monzo’s business banking offerings - providing clear, factual information and helping them evaluate what works best.</li> <li>Being a product expert: fully understand Monzo's business banking products, features and services.</li> <li>Managing a pipeline of leads with strong attention to data hygiene: timely follow-ups, accurate forecasting, deal tracking.</li> <li>Driving activation: not just closing, but ensuring new business customers are fully set up, onboarded, and are using Monzo for their banking needs.</li> <li>Collaborating internally: work closely with marketing, product, risk and customer operations to ensure a smooth journey for customers.</li> <li>Delivering outstanding service at every touchpoint: via phone, video, email or digital channels.</li> <li>Achieving sales targets: conversion, activations, revenue, engagement and other growth metrics as set by the commercial leadership.</li> <li>Feeding insights back: capture and share customer feedback — customer pain points, required features, suggestions for product improvements.</li> <li>Adapting & iterate: Things will change rapidly and often - you’ll need to be comfortable with ambiguity and change and help support what comes next.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have experience in Small Business sales, ideally selling business solutions or financial services; knowing how to engage business customers and understand their mindset, needs and pain points.</li> <li>Have a proven track record of meeting (or exceeding) sales quotas / targets in a performance-driven environment.</li> <li>Are an expert at managing a full sales cycle: from prospecting to activation, including structured and rigorous outreach and follow-ups and cross-team coordination.</li> <li>Have high emotional intelligence and are able to quickly connect and build a relationship with customers of diverse backgrounds and levels of knowledge.</li> <li>Are a strategic communicator,  excellent at building trust and helping customers discover value - you’re consultative, you listen, you ask insightful questions.</li> <li>Are adaptable and resilient, you embrace change and have a strong winning mindset to see challenges as opportunities to learn and grow.</li> <li>Can communicate clearly: written, verbal, via video; you simplify complex topics for customers.</li> <li>Are coachable and comfortable seeking constructive criticism to empower continuous learning and improvement</li> <li>Are comfortable working in a fast-moving, high change environment. You thrive when things aren’t fully defined yet.</li> <li>Can demonstrate high levels of personal organisation: tracking your pipeline, managing your time, prioritising your leads and follow-up tasks.</li> <li>Have integrity and strong consumer duty awareness: regulatory compliance, knowing your customer, reducing risk, safeguarding data and ensuring we put consumer duty first are foundational to this role and our culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus / Nice-to-haves:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience in a regulated environment (banking)</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce</li> <li>Familiarity with SMBs in specific verticals (e.g. food & drink, professional services, construction)</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £67,000 Total OTE (base salary + commission)</p> <p>📍 4 days a week in our London office but with occasional flexibility to work remotely (in the UK)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has the following key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Phone call with recruiter (30 mins)</li> <li>Sales experience video interview with Sales Lead (45 mins)</li> <li>In-person assessment: Practical task assessment + Team and Culture fit interview (90 mins)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-6 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo 🤖 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-NZ1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></strong></p> <p><strong>Help build the future of customer operations</strong></p> <p>We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Technical Program Manager</strong> to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.</p> <p>This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo</strong></p> <p>You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.</p> <p><strong>Build strong partnerships at every level</strong></p> <p>You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.</p> <p><strong>Drive change, not just delivery</strong></p> <p>You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programmes: <ul> <li>Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> <li>You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.</li> <li>You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery</li> </ul> <p>You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>What makes this role different</strong></p> <p>Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.</p> <p>You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. The programmes you lead will affect how teams across Operations work and how millions of customers get help.</p> <p>You’ll have the scope to influence strategy, the responsibility to turn it into action and the chance to build ways of working that scale.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll be your partner and guide throughout the interview process.</li> <li><strong>Initial Call (45 mins)</strong> You'll meet with one of our engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. title: Mobile Paid User Acquisition Manager (m/f/d)
description: Are you fascinated by performance marketing and can't wait to open your laptop in the morning to see how your latest ad campaign is performing? Do you eat Lookalikes for breakfast and drink coffee with CPAs? Then keep reading! About REPLUG REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value, and long-term business growth. From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently, reduce dependency on saturated acquisition channels, and build sustainable growth. Our work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across App Store Optimization, Paid User Acquisition, CRM, measurement, and mobile growth consulting. REPLUG is looking for an experienced Mobile Paid User Acquisition Manager (m/f/d) , eager to take the next steps in their mobile marketing career working in a fast-growing international agency. You will have the opportunity to deepen your knowledge of mobile paid user acquisition, working alongside top industry specialists, launching, scaling, and optimizing mobile performance campaigns for our clients' portfolio, from subscription apps to mobile games. Your responsibilities Setting up and managing performance advertising campaigns on major Paid Social Media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snapchat, TikTok, etc.). Setting up and managing campaigns on Google Ads and Apple Search Ads Managing and analyzing campaigns on main Mobile DSPs (Applovin, Moloco, Mintegral, Kayzen, Unity, etc). Taking care of MMP (Mobile Measurement Partners) setup to ensure proper monitoring by our Mobile Paid User Acquisition team Creation and updating of performance reports based on targeted KPIs on tools such as Google Sheet, Google Data Studio, Tableau, etc. Continuous analysis and optimization of user acquisition and retargeting campaigns to achieve our clients' business goals. Prepare creative briefs for our graphics team so that we always have new creative for campaigns. Use UGC (user-generated content) tools to find the best creators to promote our clients' apps. Exploring artificial intelligence tools to improve our creative production process and our advertising activities in general Answer our clients' questions on campaigns, performance and setup independently, and explain why the numbers look the way they do. Take responsibility for your accounts' targets and KPIs, flag early when we're at risk of missing them, and come with concrete proposals for what to do about it. Consult with our clients on tracking & analytics topics such as SKAN, MMP, Attribution, etc. Requirements You have 3+ years of proven success in managing paid user acquisition channels for mobile applications You have in-depth knowledge of the main Mobile Measurement Partners tools (Adjust, Appsflyer, Branch, Kochava, etc.) and know all about tracking and attribution You know how to set up Apple's SKAd network You are familiar with Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or other BI tools You understand the importance of reporting, both to improve results and to show the client how good you are. You have good presentation skills and can use Google Slides, Keynote and Power Point You believe that small details can make a big difference You like to question every accomplishment to figure out how to improve. You keep track of your own open items, hit the deadlines you commit to, and raise it early when something is at risk, instead of waiting to be asked. You are proactive and bring an entrepreneurial mindset to the team You're a firm believer in sharing knowledge and eager to contribute to the community through content creation and speaking engagements You are fluent in English, but other languages are welcome. Plus: Basic understanding of app store optimization strategies. Plus: Use of tools such as Claude, Canva, Midjourney, CapCut is highly valued. We know it's a lot of requirements, but we value transparency and like to be clear up front about what we expect from you :-) Working conditions and perks Home Office support for your remote setup. Mentoring sessions to support your professional development. Remote work flexibility based across the European Union. Vouchers and discounts. 24 vacation days per year. Competitive base + performance-driven commission High autonomy, zero bureaucracy Direct access to founders and decision-makers Education budget (courses, conferences, certifications) Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

guidance).</li> <li>Triaging cases with a value of more than £59,999.00 for upwards escalation</li> <li>Safeguarding compromised accounts and taking appropriate remedial action to ensure customers can resume safe usage of their Monzo account.</li> <li>Providing advice and support to victims of fraud on how they can protect themselves in the future.</li> <li>Handling non-FOS complaints and feeding back to Investigators and their managers where required as part of our continuous improvement feedback loop.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>A strong understanding of regulatory requirements in fraud and/or financial crime</li> <li>A strong knowledge of cryptocurrency and how this is used in fraud typologies </li> <li>Excellent English written & values</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £31,100 - £39,350 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training <p>➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of<a href="https://monzo.com/careers"> benefits</a></p> <p><strong>🌈 The Interview Process:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Some initial application questions (please take your time, we read these carefully!)</li> <li>A short call with a Recruiter</li> <li>A remote interview, lasting approximately 1 hour with two team members from the Fraud Team.</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. title: Director of Enterprise AI and Data Strategy
description: <div class="description content"> <p>We are looking for a Director-level Market Lead to head our Data & AI practice in the UK & Ireland. This is a hybrid leadership role. You combine deep technical solutioning with real commercial skill, and you are credible both in an architecture debate and across the table from a CDO, CIO or CFO.</p> <p>Our delivery model is shifting from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first pods working against a business outcome. As Market Lead, you will shape how we take that model to UKI clients: what we sell, how we price it, and how we staff and deliver it. You will lead a core team of 5–6 direct reports and a wider matrix of around 50-75 people across UKI, and you will help them build the skills this shift requires. We are developing these ways of working together.</p> <p> </p> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>The successful candidate is a true dual-threat practitioner, equally at home in a complex architecture discussion and in closing a large commercial deal.</li> <li>Drive commercial success on complex Data & AI deals across UKI, from shaping the opportunity through to a signed deal. This includes structuring fixed-price and outcome-linked commercial models, and understanding delivery cost, margin and risk.</li> <li>Partner with tech advisory and industry domain leads from pre-sale through delivery, so the commercial story, the architecture and the sector insight reinforce one another.</li> <li>Frame and test business-outcome hypotheses with executives, and define thin slices of delivery that prove value quickly.</li> <li>You stay close enough to delivery to know what is realistic, and you share accountability for outcomes on the deals you sell.</li> <li>Spearhead growth of the UKI Data & AI practice: build, lead, scale and mentor a high-performing team.</li> <li>Work with delivery and talent leads to match demand with capacity, so the right people and pods are available when deals land. Keep specialist skills sourced and bench waste low.</li> <li>Shift the practice's capability mix towards production AI engineering and agentic delivery, through hiring, reskilling and role-based onboarding.</li> <li>Manage executive-level relationships with CDOs, CIOs, CISOs and other CXOs. Act as a sparring partner on AI strategy: challenge assumptions, size the opportunity, and help clients decide where agentic automation and AI can move the P&L.</li> <li>Build and manage robust sales pipelines and lead strategic client workshops.</li> <li>Advise clients on responsible AI, covering risk, governance and regulatory expectations in the UK and wider markets.</li> <li>Expected to lead title: Product Integration Engineer, Defence
description: We're looking for a Product Integration Engineer to develop and prove out our products with military customers, starting with the Field Operator HUD (FOH): a head-mounted, always-on visual intelligence system built from Distance hardware, a HUD operating system and AI-assisted data processing that pulls sensor, feeds and command-and-control into the operator's field of view. Your job is to make it work on a specific customer's platform, in the field, not just on a bench, as part of our core R&D team. If you're a hands-on generalist who knows VR or XR and would rather be where the tech meets the user than stuck at a desk, this one's for you. WHY DISTANCE? At Distance Technologies, the problem we're solving is simple to state and hard to solve: the amount of data in the world is endless, but human capacity is not. We are building a fundamentally new perception layer between humans and machines, transforming transparent surfaces into interfaces unlike the world has ever seen. Think of the windscreen of a car, the visor of a helmet, or a sight device, each becoming a new front-end for AI. The way we turn bits and atoms into expanded human perception is protected by over 50 granted international patent families. We build it for two demanding worlds: defence and automotive. And we build it from a single foundation fusing software, hardware and computational optics. There are 60 of us today, with decades-long experience building world's best products, optics, and open-source operating systems. We partner and build with globally leading companies like KIA , Supacat , and Galvion , and we were Google Ventures' first investment in Finland. THE ROLE The FOH is already in field trials with military users. Your first project is getting it working with British Army equipment and defence primes, building the integration around what the customer actually needs. As our product line grows you'll take on a widening set of customer integrations across our defence work, each one a different platform, stack and set of interfaces. Your core responsibilities include: Owning customer integrations end to end. Make the FOH work inside a customer's platform: adapt the software, wire it into their sensors, displays, video and connectivity, and get it demo- and trial-ready. Prototype fast in dedicated environments to prove value with a client before it hits the shared codebase. Being Distance in the field. Join demos, trials and exercises with defence clients, support on-site deployments when needed, and bring back what you see and hear on real kit. Bridging the field and the core. Turn what customers need into concrete integration work with the R&D and commercial teams, spot what should become shared product capability, and feed it into the roadmap and, eventually, the shared codebase. You won't be a satellite. You'll join the software standups and reviews and be a real part of R&D. WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU Your work ships and gets used. What you integrate goes into real kit already in trials with military users, and what you learn from demos, trials and exercises with them feeds straight back into the product. You own the whole thread. From first prototype to working integration in the field, it's yours, not passed between five teams. New display tech. Glasses-free computational optics and a see-through HUD, the kind of problem you won't find at most XR jobs. A small team backed to move fast. Around 60 of us, Google Ventures' first investment in Finland, and flat enough that your calls count. OUR EXPECTATIONS What we're looking for: A builder, not a passenger: a hands-on self-starter who takes ownership, works things out when docs are missing, and would rather be with a customer or in the field than at a desk. At least a couple of years of software engineering experience with VR or XR, plus generalist instincts. Comfort across a mixed software stack. You've worked with some of C++, Unity and embedded, and you pick up the rest quickly. Some exposure to electrical integration or software-to-hardware interfaces. We're not expecting deep hardware experience on top of strong software. You're at home in prototype and integration work: incomplete docs, customer-specific stacks, messy interfaces. Good with clients, and happy to be the person representing Distance at a demo or trial. Willing to travel within the UK when needed, and to Finland now and then. It's a bonus, though not required, if you've worked with HMDs, wearable displays or spatial computing, know C++ for integration and application development, can stand up a UI or application stack for quick situational-awareness or demo prototypes, are comfortable with embedded or Linux at integration level, or have seen sensor, display and video interfaces at system level. You'll be based within commuting distance of the Bath office and in the office two to three days a week. Our working language is English. DID WE GET YOU INTERESTED? Apply via the application form. Our recruitment process includes 2-3 discussions with the team. If you want to learn more about the position, reach out to our recruiter, Joel Kinnunen, at We process your application data only for this recruitment and in line with applicable data privacy law. title: Head of Applied AI
description: Head of Applied AI Location: Our offices are in Central London, along with several of our customers. You do not need active SC clearance as we will undertake checks upon you joining, but you must be eligible to pass SC clearance. DV clearance may be required for certain roles, so the ability/willingness to pass DV clearance is advantageous but not essential. About Cloudscaler Cloudscaler is a rapidly growing cloud consultancy. We partner with ambitious enterprise and public sector customers to design, build, operate, and support secure, governed cloud platforms that meet the highest regulatory and industry standards. We are scaling deliberately. Our revenue ambition depends on deploying the right people onto the right work quickly, and on making disciplined use of our capacity. This role is central to that. About the role Cloudscaler's Applied AI business unit launched at the start of 2026 and has grown quickly, with an established offering, live client engagements and a pipeline in place. The current Head of Applied AI is stepping back from the role for personal reasons and remains with the business to hand over, so the incoming Head inherits a running unit rather than a standing start. We are recruiting to take it into its next phase of growth. The work is running; the structure is not yet. Offerings are defined, collateral exists, engagements are live and Cloudscaler's public voice on applied AI is established. What does not yet exist is the shape around it: there is no ring-fenced team, no separate P&L and no formally defined roles. The unit began with strategy, technical expertise and sales all held in one place. Technical capability has grown since; strategy and commercial ownership have not. Formalising the practice - defining the team, the roles and the commercial structure - is part of the job rather than something the incoming Head inherits finished. This role has both external and internal responsibilities: Externally, it owns our AI go-to-market offerings and the customer, partner and pre-sales activity that turns them into pipeline, and it is Cloudscaler's public voice on applied AI. Internally, it carries full commercial accountability for the business unit, provides technical delivery oversight, builds and leads the practice, and is accountable for enabling the whole company to work with AI. The role reports to the CTO and works closely with leadership across the business. The person needs to be technical enough to direct and challenge the engineering work, and commercially credible enough to scale the unit and its offering. It is a hands-on role. In one week, you might write a business case for the Leadership Team, advise a client CTO on their AI strategy, review an engineer's architecture decision and speak at a conference on what we have learned. External responsibilities These responsibilities are customer-facing, partner-facing and public facing: Relentless client focus - Maintaining a relentless client focus, calibrated to how mature the business unit is, and being decisive about where to concentrate effort and what to stop. Early on that means client meetings and pipeline growth; later it means shifting weight to larger, more sustainable areas of demand. AI go-to-market offerings - Defining and owning our AI go-to-market offerings, working with sales to take them to market. For each offering, defining what it is, who buys it, the problem it solves, its indicative price and its delivery model, and reviewing the set as the market moves, retiring what no longer sells and evolving what does. Customer relationships - Building trusted-advisor relationships with our customers, from CTOs and CDOs to engineering leaders, advising at every level and translating the same insight into the right language for a C-suite sponsor setting strategy and for the developers implementing it. Converting those relationships into repeat work and referenceable engagements. Pre-sales leadership - Leading pre-sales activity on AI opportunities, from qualification through to proposal. Supporting the delivery and commercial teams on proposals, workshops and pitches, and leading on bids where applied AI credibility is the differentiator. Qualifying opportunities in or out, including declining those we should not pursue. Client collateral - Developing reusable client collateral (opportunity assessments, roadmaps and business cases) grounded in real delivery experience. Keeping it current as the offerings and the technology move and making it available to the delivery and commercial teams rather than rebuilt for each deal. Partner and industry relationships - Building and owning our AI partner and industry relationships (AWS, Anthropic, OpenAI and relevant industry bodies), including the technical relationship, joint go-to-market activity, and achieving and maintaining the respective AI partner competencies that matter to our customers. An existing network inside our partners is a significant advantage, as is fluency in how each organisation works, where it sits in the market and what it is seeking to achieve commercially. Deciding which competencies to pursue and in what order and keeping them current. Thought leadership and public voice - Providing thought leadership on applied AI and establishing Cloudscaler's public voice through speaking, meetups, blogs and whitepapers. Building our standing in external applied AI communities and contributing to industry discussion, with material grounded in work we have delivered. Market awareness - Tracking the AI market as it moves - model releases, tooling and emerging frameworks - and forming a clear view on what is credible, what is hype, and what Cloudscaler should adopt. Bringing that view to the Leadership Team early enough to act on it, and setting our position on what we adopt, what we monitor and what we set aside. Internal responsibilities These responsibilities cover the commercial, delivery and capability side of the business unit. Commercial accountability - Carrying full commercial accountability for the business unit, which is run as its own business and measured on clear financial metrics: pipeline, revenue and gross profit. In the first six months that means a six-month revenue plan, with forecast gross profit covering the cost of the leader within six months and the team gross profit positive within two quarters. This grows into full P&L ownership as the unit scales, including team economics that stand on their own. Reporting and investment cases - Reporting to the Leadership Team on monthly KPIs covering pipeline, utilisation and gross profit against the six-month plan, and building the investment cases that fund the unit's growth. Reporting runs from month one, including the business case for establishing a dedicated team. Technical delivery oversight - Providing technical delivery oversight of AI customer engagements, working with our delivery teams. This is an architect's role rather than an engineer's: technical enough to hold your own with client engineers and to delegate the detail, and disciplined enough not to commit to capabilities we cannot feasibly deliver. Reviewing architecture and design decisions and acting as the decision-maker when a technical call is needed. Building and leading the practice - Building and leading our AI practice: owning Cloudscaler's AI strategy and the roadmap to deliver it, hiring and line-managing the team as it grows, capability development, and a repeatable methodology and delivery standards that make quality consistent regardless of who is leading the engagement. Defining the capability model and establishing the practice as an internal centre of excellence for review and quality assurance as it grows. Decomposing and delegating ownership - Breaking broad areas of activity into distinct responsibilities that can be delegated and genuinely owned, and building the team to hold them. The scope of this role is deliberately broader than one person can carry: the expectation is that the Head of Applied AI grows a team around them - including the AI enablement hires already in train - and leads through that team rather than delivering everything personally. Internal AI usage guidance, reviewing internal projects, pre-sales attendance, marketing campaigns and enablement workshops each need a named owner; an informal approach works while the unit is small but will not scale. Accelerators and intellectual property - Building reusable AI accelerators and intellectual property that shorten and de-risk customer delivery. Registering the assets as the work matures - accelerators, frameworks and reference architectures - and working with engineering to keep them testable and current as models and tooling evolve. Treating them as Cloudscaler intellectual property with standalone value rather than delivery tools alone. Company-wide AI enablement - Enabling every Cloudscaler employee to work with AI, including defining our internal AI learning pathways. Setting the guidance for how AI is used in our own work and running the enablement activity that puts it into everyday use across the whole company rather than the practice alone. Internal community of practice - Growing an internal AI community of practice, giving colleagues outside the team a route to learn and contribute. Running it as a standing forum rather than ad-hoc sessions, so that colleagues outside the practice can build AI capability alongside their own work. Candidate profile This is a senior role combining technical depth with commercial ownership. We expect candidates to demonstrate the following: Technical depth in applied AI - Current, hands-on understanding of AI technologies, models and tooling, sufficient to direct development work, review architecture and design decisions, and hold credible technical conversations with client engineers and architects. Commercial track record - Experience owning a revenue or gross profit target, building the pipeline behind it, and reporting against a plan. Comfortable being measured on financial outcomes rather than activity. Consulting and client credibility - A strong communicator who can advise at C-suite level and at engineering level, and whom clients want in the room on their most significant decisions. Practice or capability building - Experience building a team or capability from a small base: hiring, setting delivery standards, and creating repeatable methodology rather than relying on individual heroics. Partner ecosystem experience - Familiarity with the AWS and Anthropic ecosystems, or a comparable hyperscaler and model-vendor landscape, including how partner competencies and joint go-to-market activity work in practice. External profile - A track record of public contribution on applied AI, or the clear appetite and ability to build one. Leadership and delegation - Experience leading and line-managing a technical team, including setting direction, delegating genuine ownership and developing people. Comfortable achieving outcomes through a team rather than personally delivering the work. Judgement and prioritisation - The ability to decide where to concentrate a small team's effort, and the discipline to stop work that is not producing. description: <div> <p><strong>Location</strong>: London, UK</p> <p><strong>Weekly office requirement:</strong> Minimum 2 days per week<br><strong>Employment type:</strong> permanent<br><br><br>At GWI we’re always looking for extraordinary people who thrive on making an extraordinary impact. Right now we’re looking for an Account Director to play a key role in our Enterprise Tech & Media team in London. If that’s you, and making a difference gets you out of bed in the morning, keep reading. It could be the start of something, well, extraordinary.</p> <br> <h1>Sounds great, what will I be doing? 🤔</h1> <p>As an Account Director in the Enterprise Tech & Media team, you’ll help support our global expansion, working across our most lucrative Tech clients, like Meta and Microsoft. GWI is the world's most revealing data set on consumer behaviors. We work with the world's largest Media Owners, Agencies and Brands to help drive smarter marketing decisions and generate revenue.</p> <br>A few things you’ll be responsible for: </div> <h3>👉 Work closely with your Senior Director Tech & Media to intensify and expand your tech platform client relationships.</h3> <p>👉 Help to drive and execute the expansion strategy and grow assigned portfolio year-on-year; including building client mappings and ability to perform gap analysis</p> <p>👉 Negotiate with key stakeholders and regularly closing opportunities.</p> <p>👉 Regularly lead client conversations and detailed presentations face-to-face, via email, on the phone and via screen share.</p> <p>👉 Identify and engage with key target contacts via personal network, qualified in-bound leads and proactive outbound engagement with key DM’s in defined vertical against defined corporate targets</p> <p>👉 Project-manage and prepare client presentations by using GWI datasets and deliver tailored pitch and proposal documents</p> <p>👉 Diligent approach to tracking all conversations and managing all sales opportunities via Salesforce.</p> <p>👉 Stay up-to-date on key developments and changes within the GWI product eco-system; as well as have an acute awareness of wider developments in the digital and media advertising landscape.<br><br>It’s also fun; shaking things up is what working for GWI is all about. You’ll need to be flexible, comfortable with continuous change, and working in a high-tempo environment.</p> <h1>What do I need to bring with me? 🧳</h1> <p>You’ll need to be able to demonstrate the core skills this role requires. You don't have to tick all the boxes right away; the important thing is that you’re willing to learn. Here’s what the team will be looking for in you:</p> <p>👉 Proven Account Management experience working with top tier clients in the media, platform, advertising or research industry.</p> <p>👉 Commercial Tenacity & Resilience: Unwavering determination and drive to consistently surpass client expectations and revenue goals, remaining composed, optimistic, and focused during high-stakes renewal and expansion negotiations.</p> <p>👉 Knowledge/network of clients of the media/advertising industry.</p> <p>👉 Detailed understanding of the SaaS revenue model and how to identify growth potentials</p> <p>👉 Great knowledge in consumer research and how current trends change their behavior.</p> <p>👉 Proven track of working in the research sector, including knowledge of quant and qual methodologies</p> <p>👉 Negotiate with key stakeholders and regularly closing opportunities.  - a driver for this skill could be 'Relationship building' </p> <p>👉Excellent communication and influencing skills; able to build trust at C-level.</p> <p>👉Strategic thinker with commercial acumen and problem-solving skills.</p> <p><br>Why Join Us</p> <p>👉 Be part of something that matters. Join a disruptor shaping the global market research industry, where your work drives real impact</p> <p>👉 Think big, move fast. You'll be immersed in the fast-moving world of data tech, working on problems that actually challenge you</p> <p>👉 Collaboration at the core. Thrive in a forward-thinking team that values ambition, curiosity, and genuine respect for one another</p> <p>👉 A culture that trusts you. We're not afraid to ask why, and neither should you be. Entrepreneurial spirit is celebrated here</p> <h1>Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 🫶</h1> <p>Diversity is fundamental to who we are—as a data company and as a workplace. Our data reflects global realities, and so must our teams. We strive to build a workforce as diverse and inclusive as the insights we deliver.</p> <p>As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled candidates and are committed to making adjustments throughout the hiring process—whether that's extra time, materials in advance or a different format, breaks, an adjusted interview format, assistive tools, or flexible scheduling. We're happy to discuss whatever would work best for you.</p> <p>We actively encourage applications from underrepresented and marginalised communities.</p> <p>At GWI, you'll find a place to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and belong fully.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/y97yWcrpLTE" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>#li-hybrid<br>#LI-VS01</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Manager, Product Partnerships
description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the Role Perk works best when it connects seamlessly with the tools and platforms our customers already rely on. From ERP and accounting systems to workplace software, mobility providers, technology platforms, and emerging AI ecosystems, these third-party relationships can directly shape the value customers get from Perk. We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Product Partnerships to own and build those relationships. Unlike our Growth Partnerships and Supplier Partnerships teams, this role isn’t responsible for generating sales pipeline or supplier commission revenue. Its goal is to make Perk’s product and customer experience stronger through the third parties we depend on and integrate with. You’ll determine where strategic relationships can unlock the most customer value, build and manage those partnerships, secure the access and agreements our teams need, and work closely with Product and Engineering to turn them into successful customer-facing experiences. This is a new role at Perk with significant opportunity to define how Product Partnerships should work as we scale. What You’ll Do Build our product partnership strategy: Translate Perk’s product and company priorities into a clear roadmap of third-party relationships across areas such as ERP and accounting, business software, mobility, integration platforms, and AI. Own strategic partner relationships: Serve as Perk’s primary relationship owner for the external platforms and technology companies that enable or enhance customer-facing product experiences. Unlock Product and Engineering: Secure the developer access, API licences, programme memberships, certifications, marketplace approvals, and other partner support our teams need to build and maintain integrations. Structure and negotiate partnerships: Lead commercial and strategic discussions around API access, data, licensing, marketplace participation, co-marketing, and other partnership terms, working closely with Legal, Security, Finance, Product, and Engineering. Partner with Product on priorities: Bring the partner and market perspective into roadmap discussions while Product Managers own product requirements and delivery. Help determine which external relationships and integration models create the greatest customer value. Own the partner lifecycle: Manage relationships from initial engagement through integration, certification, launch, ongoing roadmap alignment, escalations, programme changes, and renewals. Drive adoption and customer value: Work with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Support to ensure partnerships aren’t simply launched—they are discoverable, useful, reliable, and adopted by customers. Build the Product Partnerships playbook: Establish how Perk evaluates, prioritises, launches, measures, and manages product partnerships as this function grows. What We’re Looking For Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ecosystem partnerships, business development, or a product-adjacent role within SaaS, fintech, or B2B technology. Experience building and managing complex relationships with technology or platform companies, ideally including developer, API, certification, or marketplace programmes. Comfortable working with Product and Engineering and understanding technical concepts such as APIs, OAuth, data models, sandboxes, and integration dependencies without needing to be an engineer. Ability to distinguish between an interesting partnership and one that will meaningfully improve Perk’s product or customer experience. Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills across both external partners and senior internal stakeholders. Able to move complex initiatives forward across Product, Engineering, Legal, Security, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Sales without relying on direct authority. Comfortable defining the strategy, operating model, priorities, and processes for a new function rather than inheriting an established playbook. Able to build the case for a partnership and measure its impact through adoption, customer experience, integration quality, and other relevant outcomes. Based within commuting distance of our London or Barcelona hub. Nice to Have Experience with ERP, accounting, spend management, payments, travel, or fintech ecosystems. Experience managing relationships with major business software, technology, mobility, or AI platforms. Familiarity with unified API or integration-platform models. Experience with European ERP and accounting ecosystems across markets such as DACH, Benelux, France, the Nordics, or the UK. Additional European languages. What We Offer Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support The Process Talent Acquisition Interview - 30 mins - Virtual Hiring Manager Interview - 30 mins - Virtual Assessment Interview - 60 mins - IRL / Virtual Values interview - 30 mins - Virtual AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes. How We Work At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work. For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume. Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you. Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate. #LI-Hybrid Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Diesel Mechanic
description: Saronic Technologies is a leader in revolutionizing autonomy at sea, dedicated to developing state-of-the-art solutions that enhance maritime operations through autonomous and intelligent platforms. Job Overview We are currently seeking a skilled Diesel Mechanic to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining, repairing, and troubleshooting diesel engines and related systems on our autonomous surface vessels (ASVs) to ensure optimal performance and reliability. Responsibilities Perform routine maintenance tasks on diesel engines, including oil changes, filter replacements, and fluid checks, to ensure proper functioning and longevity. Diagnose and repair diesel engine malfunctions, mechanical issues, and electrical faults using diagnostic tools, technical manuals, and troubleshooting techniques. Inspect and test diesel engine components, systems, and subsystems to identify and address potential problems or areas of concern. Overhaul and rebuild diesel engines and associated systems, including fuel injection systems, turbochargers, and exhaust systems, as needed to restore performance and efficiency. Maintain accurate records of maintenance and repair activities, including parts used, labour hours, and service performed, to track equipment history and ensure compliance with maintenance schedules and regulatory requirements. Follow safety protocols and procedures for working with diesel engines and related equipment, including proper handling and disposal of hazardous materials and fluids. Collaborate with other maintenance technicians, engineers, and operators to troubleshoot complex problems, share technical knowledge, and implement effective solutions. Qualifications Marine Diesel and/or Volvo VODIA experience required GCSEs (or equivalent) are required. A recognised vocational qualification or apprenticeship in diesel mechanics, marine engineering, or a related discipline is preferred. Proven experience as a diesel technician or a diesel mechanic, with demonstrated proficiency in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining diesel engines and related systems. Strong mechanical aptitude and technical skills, with the ability to read and interpret technical manuals, diagrams, and schematics. Familiarity with diagnostic tools and equipment used in diesel engine repair, such as scan tools, multimeters, and oscilloscopes. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical and electrical issues. Effective communication skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team. Willingness to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with changing priorities and deadlines. Ability to travel as needed to meet business objectives, including throughout the Indo-Pacific region and to our headquarters in Austin, Texas. This role will require spending 30+ days training at Saronic headquarters in Austin, Texas. Physical Demands Ability to perform physically demanding work for extended periods. Frequently and repetitively lift, push, and carry up to 23 kg's. Ability to work outdoors for extended periods in marine and waterside environments. Frequently and repetitively bend, lift, and reach to install and remove components of varying size and weight. Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, including over varied and uneven terrain such as docks, vessel decks, and gravel surfaces. Stoop, lay, bend, reach, squat, kneel, crouch, twist, and crawl for extended periods while working in confined or low-clearance spaces. Climb and maintain balance on ladders, platforms, vessels, and other elevated structures. Exposure to loud noise, vibration, engine exhaust, and hazardous materials with required adherence to safety and disposal procedures. Wear Personal Protective Equipment at all times in work areas, including safety glasses, gloves, hearing protection, steel-toed footwear, and other PPE as required. Benefits Stock Options: Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success Competitive Salary: Industry-standard salaries with opportunities for performance-based bonuses Medical Insurance: Comprehensive private health insurance Time Off: Generous annual leave entitlement, plus public holidays. Parental Leave: Paid maternity and paternity leave to support new parents This role requires the legal right to work in the United Kingdom. Employment may also be subject to applicable security, export control, and government contracting requirements. title: Graduate Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Hiring now We are hiring as soon as possible. This role is for someone who has already graduated, or who will complete their degree in time to start with us very soon. We are not able to consider final-year students who graduate in summer 2027 or later, and this is not a graduate scheme with a fixed annual intake. Role Overview This is a first full-time engineering role on the NEO-1 satellite. You will design satellite hardware and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised as the design matures, learning from our lead designer and working in a small, multidisciplinary team. You will take ownership of real parts early, translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing. Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, such as brackets, panels, component mounts, thermal-control hardware and cable and harness routing, with guidance from the lead designer. Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, learning how to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model. Support assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released. Run interference and clash checks and help maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts. Produce dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings using GD&T, with review from senior engineers. Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers. Work with manufacturers and suppliers to make designs easier to build, and to balance cost, mass and reliability. Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results. Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform. Required Skills & Experience Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline, completed or completing very soon. Hands-on 3D CAD skills from university projects, a placement or an internship (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered). Working knowledge of GD&T and experience producing engineering drawings, including from coursework or a team project. Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics. Evidence of designing, building and testing something real, such as a placement project, Formula Student, a UAV, or a rocketry or satellite team, including troubleshooting and iteration. Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team. Preferred Experience A placement, internship or year in industry in aerospace, space, motorsport or another high-reliability field. Experience of several people working in one CAD assembly, for example in a Formula Student or university team, including how files and revisions were controlled. Exposure to PLM or PDM systems (for example 3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX'), Windchill, Teamcenter, ENOVIA or SolidWorks PDM) or to formal engineering change processes (ECO/ECR/ECN). Experience of design reviews, documented requirements and standards. Satellite, CubeSat or rocketry project experience, including hardware that has launched. Basic FEA familiarity and exposure to manufacturing processes. Why NewOrbit Space? Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO. Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology. Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success. Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups. Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week. Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
